description:
List the files the user uploaded to LuBot.

    Returns file id, name, type, upload time and row or chunk count,
    newest first. Use this when the user asks about their uploaded
    files, and to find the file_id that analyze_file needs.

    Limits: requires sign-in; up to 100 files. Users with no uploads yet
    see demo files, clearly labeled.
name: list_files

FileMeta.description:
Public-facing metadata for one file the caller owns.

`file_id` is an opaque string — never a raw DB primary key path or
filesystem path — so a compromised token can't be used to probe
internal storage layout.
FileMeta.title: FileMeta

outputSchema.description:
`list_files` structured result (MARKET-17 S6-4 outputSchema).

Same JSON as before: {"files": [...]}.
outputSchema.title: FileList

title: List My Files
